searchText: EIPs GitHub page renderer has a critical vulnerability (can lead to RCE). We *really* need someone we trust with Ruby experience who can evaluate and apply fixes to these sorts of things... https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4865 auto-merged rather than waiting for other editors to review/approve. Can <@!683653554631868440> <@!543900561460822016> <@!425279588009246720> <@!689161464829050960> take a look so I can revert it if necessary? (it is very short/simple, I just don't like bypassing the process) Should we also add common editors and OS files? I usually use something like: https://www.toptal.com/developers/gitignore/api/vim,windows,osx,sublimetext,linux I'm generally not a fan of kitchen sink gitignore files. If there are things people *actually* use related to the project I support adding them, but I dislike just throwing *everything* into a list because auditing becomes harder.
